name: Waffle Chart
summary: 10 × 10 unit grid (1 square = 1%) for part-to-whole — one stacked waffle with a legend table, waffles faceted by a field, or small multiples per category.
summary_zh: 10 × 10 百格图（每格 = 1%）表达部分与整体：单个堆叠百格图配图例表、按字段分面的多个百格图，或每个类别一个小百格图。
description_zh: 用 100 个方格直观展示占比，比饼图更容易数清楚“几成”，适合股东结构、收入构成、客户集中度等。数据为长表：label 为类别、value 为数值（同类多行自动汇总），按最大余数法分配格数，保证合计正好 100 格；超过 maxCategories 的小类合并为灰色“Others”。三种用法：单个堆叠百格图（右侧图例表列出数值与占比）；设置 encode.facet 按地区等字段拆成多个百格图横向对比；mode = 'facet' 时每个类别一个小百格图，只填充该类别份额并在下方给出大号百分比。悬停聚焦某一类别，点击交叉筛选。
best_for: Headline 'x in 10' messages on summary pages
Comparing the same mix across regions or years (facet)
Single-share small multiples (e.g. % recurring revenue by segment)
avoid_when: Precise values must be read (pair with the legend table or use a bar)

label.desc: Category (rows sharing a label are aggregated)

facet.desc: Split into one stacked waffle per value of this field (e.g. region, year)

mode.desc: stacked (one waffle, or one per encode.facet value) | facet (one small waffle per category)

scale.desc: auto (absolute when the value is a % field summing to ≤ 100%, else share) | share (normalise to the total) | absolute (values are fractions 0–1 of a whole; the rest stays empty)

maxCategories.desc: Categories beyond this are grouped into othersLabel

othersLabel.desc: Name of the grey grouped category

agg.desc: Aggregation for rows sharing a label

fillOrder.desc: row (left → right, top → bottom) | column (bottom → top, left → right)

highlight.desc: Category drawn in the accent colour

legend.desc: Legend table beside a single waffle, inline legend above several

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field format

interactions: Squares fill in sequence when the block scrolls into view
Hover a square or legend row: that category stays in focus, tooltip with value / share / squares
Click to cross-filter ('Others' toggles all of its members)
Colours cross-fade and numbers count when filters change
